# StudentHubHelp

> StudentHubHelp is a student-focused discovery platform for finding hostels and PGs, tiffin and mess services, libraries, cafes, book stores, and related student services.

## Primary pages

- [StudentHubHelp homepage](https://studenthubhelp.in/) — Homepage and student-services discovery
- [Global search](https://studenthubhelp.in/global-search.html) — Search StudentHubHelp listings by property, service, area, city, or landmark
- [Tiffin and mess finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/tiffin-finder.html) — Tiffin and mess finder
- [Library finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/library-finder.html) — Library finder
- [Cafe finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/cafe-finder.html) — Cafe finder
- [Book store finder](https://studenthubhelp.in/bookstore-finder.html) — Book store finder
- [Student support appointments](https://studenthubhelp.in/appointment.html) — Student support and appointment requests
- [Contact StudentHubHelp](https://studenthubhelp.in/contact-us.html) — Contact and support

## Search and listing guidance

StudentHubHelp listing information can change. Availability, prices, facilities, timings, contact details, and other important information should be reconfirmed with the relevant property owner or service provider before making a decision.

A StudentHubHelp Verified badge indicates that the listing passed the platform's verification process for the information reviewed. It is not a guarantee of future availability, service quality, or safety.

## Machine-readable discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://studenthubhelp.in/sitemap.xml) — Main XML sitemap
